profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S, CIK 0001583708) founded in 2013 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company describes itself as an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform that unifies endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection through a Security Data Lake. Its site positions the platform as AI-native and built to operate at machine speed, with the stated ability to autonomously stop supply chain attacks, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse via a single lightweight agent.

The company's tracked AI product is Purple AI, categorized under Security and Identity AI. According to the site, Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine incident response, with the stated aim of freeing analysts for higher-value decisions. SentinelOne also describes its approach to security information and event management as redefining the modern SIEM category, noting recognition in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
